_: Public keys that give Priism's unpacked copies (the zips you load in chrome://extensions) the same extension id in any folder, so their uploads and settings stay when you update into a new folder. Public halves only: the id comes from these alone. Never put a key in the Chrome Web Store zip (the store refuses it). keyedFrom: the first version whose unpacked zip carries the key (see RELEASING.md: the move from an older unpacked copy).
